name: @latency-ladder/ranker-ts
description: Latency Ladder reference ranker: vendored cmdk 1.1.1 command-score with a frozen POW_0999 table, plus rank(), goldens and conform.

scripts.fixtures: node scripts/gen-fixture.ts && node scripts/gen-fixture.ts --count 50000 --out ../fixtures/f50k && node scripts/gen-fixture.ts --count 5000 --clean --out ../fixtures/f5k-clean
scripts.test:fuzz: node scripts/fuzz.ts --cases 200000 && node scripts/fuzz.ts --cases 200000 --oracle chromium --seed 2 && node scripts/fuzz.ts --cases 200000 --oracle chromium --seed 4 --wide
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rs && npm run fixtures && npm run test:diff && npm run test:fuzz && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:bitexact && npm run test:oracle
scripts.bench: cd ../ranker-rs && cargo build --release -q && ./target/release/rank-cli bench --items ../fixtures/f50k/items.json --queries ../fixtures/f50k/queries.json --repeat 3 && cd ../ranker-ts && node scripts/rank-cli.ts bench --items ../fixtures/f50k/items.json --queries ../fixtures/f50k/queries.json --repeat 3
